text: Debugging is a crucial skill for any programmer, and having a clear strategy makes it much less stressful. The first step is always to identify the bug accurately. Instead of guessing, try to reproduce the problem and understand what is actually happening versus what you expected. Once you know the symptoms, use debugging tools like breakpoints and watches to inspect your code step by step. However, tools are only half the battle; you need a systematic approach. Fix one issue at a time, test your changes regularly, and don’t be afraid to write things down. Finally, remember that logging is your friend. Adding simple log statements to track variable values and the flow of execution often reveals the root cause faster than staring at the screen. Patience, combined with these methods, will help you solve almost any problem.
